text: it could be physics, i cant walk under roofs/floors but i can walk under props
resolution: Fixed the compiled-loader fallback/windowed collider rule for raised floors/roofs: instance-derived colliders now keep their real finite vertical band instead of using solid-to-ground for thin walkable slabs, so overhead floors/roofs can be walked under like shape-aware props. Added a pure policy helper/test plus a host physics regression for walking under a raised finite-band slab. Verified focused tests and no-JS loader screenshot.
